lines: The fight was against a formidable enemy, Yamata no Orochi...
However, it became a surprisingly one-sided battle.
Aieeee!! Ms. Yamata no Orochi, I'm sorryyyyyyyy!!
Even though he was scared, Shikanosuke threw his shuriken while staying out of range.
―Here it comes!! Octopus Tentacle Four Blade Style: Tentacle Slash!!
And then, following Hebiko's attack from mid-range―
Heeheehee♪ Hey lady, you might want to guard your feet～
Arrrrrghh, you braaaats!! Stop scampering about already!!!
Yamata no Orochi swung her giant sword about, her expression filled with rage.
The tip of her sword, however, scraped against the ceiling of the narrow tunnel and got jammed.
And in that opening, Sakura disappeared effortlessly from the shadow at her feet.
The more agitated she became, the more the female warrior's sword banged against the tunnel walls, and the more her movements slowed.
―You've got to watch your surroundings better you know? That huge sword of yours is just a handicap in this narrow tunnel.
Anticipating that, I had chosen the remains of the mine as the site for our fight with this berserker.
It was an ideal location for Sakura, who used Shadow Jutsu and wielded weapons on the smaller side.
And if, on top of that, we broke her concentration with Hebiko's mid-range and Shikanosuke's long-range attacks―
Then even if there was a large gap in strength, we should be able to deal with her easily.
Yamata no Orochi's huge body was quickly becoming covered in wounds.
Aarrgh!!! Ugh... Hm-hm... hm-hm-hm-hm!! Aaah, alright, alright!!
Hm-hm! Yeah, I surrender. ―Fuma Kotaro!!! Next time I'll definitely kill you―
Her response took us by surprise...
But I guess you had to hand it to an experienced mercenary.
Seeing that the situation was not to her advantage, Yamata no Orochi had quickly turned on her heels and darted away into the darkness of the mine shafts.
No, Sakura, leave her be! If she wants to run then let her.
Sakura had been about to chase after her without hesitation, but I had stopped her.
She's crazy strong, that one. So much so that I don't even know what we would've done without your strategy, Fuma-kun―
I think now would be a perfect chance to take her down though...?
Th-That's right, Fuma!! And plus, she's probably the kind of person to hold a grudge forever!!
Hebiko also seemed to agree and nodded her head while she was supporting Sago-san.
That being said, our top priority right now is to get Sago-san back to the surface.
We just... have to make sure that we'll never cross paths with her again.
―There you are. Good job on your undercover mission.
This was the rendezvous point with the representative from Gosha sent to meet us.
Waiting for us there was Yatsu Murasaki-sensei, the powerful and peerless Taimanin who had helped us many times before.
That meant if we handed Sago-san over to her here, our mission would officially be over.
Wooooooohh!!! We did iiiiiit!! Goal! Goooaaaaaal!!
Yeahhh～♪ We did it, heberyone!! A big round of applause♪
Hebiko and Shikanosuke were beyond elated and weirdly hyped up.
Well, it had been a pretty tough mission.
(Incidentally, it would be bad if word got from Murasaki-sensei to this dimension's Sakura about the version of her here, so young Sakura was hiding in my shadow.)
So you are Sago? The government escort is waiting for you on the surface. Will you come with me, please?
Sago-san started to walk away, but looked back at us after a few steps.
I felt no purpose in anything anymore... That's what I told you that time... but now it's a little different.
What will you achieve, and how will you lead the Fuma Clan... I want to see what lies ahead.
...Though it's a wish that will not be fulfilled.
It will. I'll also do my best to make it happen.
Sago-san didn't reply and only showed something resembling a smile, and went to Murasaki-sensei.
He looked as if he had given up on everything, but also as if he had found some new hope.
―Well then, your mission is complete. You are free to return to Gosha.
No, there isn't, but... we wanted to at least see Sago-san to the surface.
I said to Murasaki-sensei on behalf of all of us.
Somehow, we didn't feel like ending our mission in such a dimly lit cavern.
Yes... To see it through to the end, you know...?
...No need for that. Aren't you all tired? Just leave the rest to me.
Murasaki-sensei's attitude was unusually indifferent to our thoughts.
Constrained by her decision, we simply watched the two of them go up the stairs to the surface.
Hebiko murmured while standing next to me and I slightly nodded my head in agreement.
He seemed hard to approach at first, but he was a really nice guy.
...Hebiko thinks so too. It would have been nice to properly see him off...
Yeah. But we were already told to head back...
It's a bit of a lonely feeling...
We stayed silent for a moment.
And then we looked at each other.
Hehe. But just for a bit―it's okay, right!?
As we stepped out to the surface, it was morning...
It seemed that while we had been running around underground, the sun had risen without us noticing.
Aaah～ Where's Sago-san... Oh!! There he is―
My eyes gradually became accustomed to the brightness.
We had come out from underground in the middle of some business district.
Across the street, Sago-san was being escorted by a government agent towards an official vehicle.
Heyyy～!! Sago-san, let's meet again someday―
―――Are you all stupid!!? I told you not to come!!
Someone yelled at us from close by.
And in the next moment―several things happened all at once.
Noticing my voice, Sago-san turned around on the other side of the street.
And his head suddenly came flying off.
From far away, the delayed sound of a single gunshot echoed through the street―.
As I stared dumbfounded, Sago-san's body limply crumpled to the ground.
In a room in a building one kilometer away from the scene.
The rifle held by a woman noisily spat out an empty cartridge.
